how.title: How it works
how.s1: First, choose your operator and amount and see your price.
how.s2: Then dial the code we show you, with our number already in it.
how.s3: Next, we check the operator’s SMS against our SIM balance.
how.s4: Finally, the dinars appear in your Sarfli balance.

rules.title: Our rules
rules.locked: The price shown when you start is the price you get, even if the daily rate changes.
rules.twice: The operator’s SMS and our SIM balance must agree before we count your credit.
rules.window: The number is reserved for you alone while you send.
rules.less: Top up the rest, or accept the price for what arrived.
rules.late: Credit that arrives late or above the amount is paid for what really arrived.
rules.limit: Sell as often as you want. Every sale adds to the same balance.

faq.title: Questions
faq.signAlt: A yellow taxiphone sign in Arabic and French
faq.a1: Prepaid credit from {operators}. Today’s rates are in the ticket above and are set once a day.
faq.q2: How do I send the credit?
faq.a2: With your operator’s own transfer code. We show the code with our number already in it, you tap it and call. The codes are {codes}.
faq.q3: When is the money in my balance?
faq.a3: As soon as the operator’s SMS and our balance check agree, usually a few minutes after you send.
faq.a4: From your balance, choose {methods}, for any amount from {min} DT. The fee is charged once per withdrawal.
faq.a5: No. Once you ask for it, we process it. If we cannot pay it, the money goes back to your balance.
faq.q6: Why do you need my phone number?
faq.a6: The operator’s SMS names the number that sent the credit. We match it to your sale, so only your credit counts.
